title: Incredibly helpful!!
body: Since I started using the app I got a positive feeling that has made a difference in how I see and manage my every day tasks. Also, the statistics remind me that I am doing better than I give my self credit for. The habit reminders are not annoying, and I love a ringtone can be recorded. The only downside I can think of is that the font size is small and can’t be adjusted.
